title: Economic impact of colonial rule
quote: India went from leading exporter of manufactures to supplier of raw materials

boxes.title: Economic nationalists
head: Thinker
Work / idea
rows: **"Poverty and Un-British Rule in India"** (1901); **"England's Debt to India" (1867)**; "moral drain"

boxes.title: Drain of wealth
items: Wealth to England **with no material return**; began with **Diwani (1765)**
**Home Charges**: India Office costs in London
Salaries, pensions; interest on debt; military expenditure
==**Profits of British capitalists**== (Naoroji) - not excess of imports
Effects: stifled capital formation; Moderates demanded cut in **salt tax**

boxes.title: Deindustrialisation
steps: Lancashire cloth in Bengal **1786**; calicoes displaced by **1793**
By **1850** India takes ==**one-fourth**== of British cotton exports
Artisans pushed to land → disguised unemployment

boxes.title: Commercialisation & famines
items: Cash revenue forced **indigo, cotton, opium, jute** → famines
Opium to China → tea to Britain → manufactures to India
**1832-33 Guntur**: ==**Dokkala / Nandana Karuvu**==, about **2 lakh** dead

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Drain "popularised by" = **Naoroji** (APPSC 2025); reason = **profits of British capitalists** (2024)
Textiles = ==second-largest employment== in Andhra after agriculture (2025)
Manganese: **Nellore** world leader **1892-1929** (⚠ other notes: Vizag)
Cotton mills Indian-owned; jute mills foreign-owned
